title.narrative: Civil Society for Inclusiveness, Democratic Governance and Human Rights, Phase II

description.narrative: Civil Society Organizations for Inclusiveness, Democratic Governance and Human: is a partnership between the Kingdom of the Netherlands, the Government of the Denmark, SIDA, and UNDP to actively contribute to democratic governance and protection of human rights in the occupied Palestinian territory (oPt). The CSO human rights community, both comprising Palestinian and Israeli actors, have played a key role throughout the years in advocating for and protecting Palestinian individual as well as collective rights in the face of a continued occupation and internal political split. This is being done in an ever more restrictive legal/regulatory environment where CSO’s are facing serious challenges resulting from obstacles being placed on their operations by both Israeli and Palestinian authorities. This in turn is having an impact on the CSO’s internal capacity or organizational development, and in their external capacity to influence debates and policies. The absence of risk management exercises in the planning stage, a weak monitoring, evaluation and reporting system, financial management constraints, and insufficient investments in partnership and resource mobilization, have also constrained CSOs organizational development. With the decline in foreign donor support, these human rights actors, are facing challenges related to their financial viability and weakened ability to provide a wide spectrum of goods and services. Thus, this project is designed in a manner that promotes a more active and effective engagement of CSOs in governance and policy dialogue, improving their quality of action and accountability in front of partners and constituencies, and for strengthening cooperation with public authorities at the local and national levels. Moreover, this project will provide a democratic space in supporting networks, unions and platforms for CSOs to define their specific role and exercise their functions accordingly.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
